notes.title: The Challenge Update - Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello Squires!  We're landing a huge game update packed with new features that will completely change your experience with The Plucky Squire!  



This update introduces two new game modes—Challenge Mode and Iron Squire Mode—along with new enemies, enemy variants, and minigame updates. So if you’ve think it was too easy, The Challenge Update might just change your mind.



Plus, we’re offering our biggest discount yet during the Steam Summer Sale!


[previewyoutube="T1K38O_msm8;full"][/previewyoutube]


Here’s the full list of new features and changes that you’ll find in The Challenge Update:  


New Challenge Mode
Challenge Mode is a new game mode designed to test your skills with increased difficulty. This mode includes:

 New enemies 

 Harder minigames

 Harder bosses 

 Some layout changes for levels 

 The ability to fast forward through dialogue and 

 New Achievements

Remixed Pages
Pages with combat on have been reworked and side scrolling levels have new layouts.  


Humgrump Desk Spawns
In the previous version of the game, we had Humgrump teleport some enemies into the level using his metamagic, but only in the book. We've now added these sequences to the desk too. These spawn in with VFX and a bubble that contains Humgrump's face. Additionally, Jot can get electrified on the desk.  


New Metamagic Enemies
Following on from the above, we have the glowing metamagic variants of some of the base enemies. They have their own effects and materials on the desk, and new sprites in the book.

 Barfer Bug

 Rat

 Goblin

 Spear Trooper

 Popuff

Challenge Mode Enemy Variants
We have some upgraded versions of the existing enemies. These are all across both desk and book.

 Tough Goblin (just harder)

 Exploding Goblins (run at you and explode)

 Metal Goblins (indestructible)

 Exploding Jumper bugs

 Tough Namastarlings (just harder)

 There's a new tough book-only enemy, the Rock Golem, which appears from Chapter 2.

More Difficult Minigame Patterns
All of the minigames, apart from the Sneak C09 game, Fish Grabbing and the C04 Fantasy Card Game have new difficulty settings and layouts. Buttergrump also has new patterns. There are little bits of extra functionality in some of these games as a result, such as ghost Archery bugs and new projectiles in Buttergrump.  


New Iron Squire Mode
The Plucky Squire with permadeath! This is essentially Challenge Mode but with no continues. As soon as you die in Iron Squire Mode, your save is deleted, and you are sent to a new game over screen. We have one each for desk and the book.  


Four New Achievements
There have been five Challenge Mode-specific achievements added.

Complete Challenge Mode: Pops up at the same point that the Adventure/Story Mode one pops up. It also auto-completes the Adventure/Story Mode too.

Get to Artia in Iron Squire Mode: This triggers at the end of C04 when the camera pans across to show Artia.

Complete all corrupted (Humgrump) Challenge Mode minigames (without skipping)

Boxing

Volleyball

Potion pop

Complete the Big Brawl at the end of C09 without dying.


Dialogue Fast Forward
You can hold the X button or Space Bar to fast forward through all dialogue without repeatedly pressing for each box that pops up.



The dev team has set up a new form so you can directly send in bug and issue reports to them. If you are encountering problems in the game on the latest versions, please send them over here: 



The Plucky Squire Public Bug Submission Form



Finally, to celebrate, The Plucky Squire is now 35% OFF in the Steam Summer Sale — our biggest discount yet! Help us spread the word! 



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627570/The_Plucky_Squire/"][/dynamiclink]

That's all for now, Squires! We hope you enjoy this new adventure!

notes.title: Version 1.15.1 adding Streamlined Mode!
notes.content:
Hello Squires! 

We’ve added a brand new mode to The Plucky Squire in today’s update. In Streamlined Mode, you’ll play through Jot’s adventures at a quicker tempo! We’ve been looking at the feedback about the game, and one of the points that came up was that the pacing was a little too slow for some players. Enter: Streamlined Mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/574632c2e69ceffd5593bbb013df893bcd88e299.png
Streamlined Mode
Streamlined mode is intended for more experienced players who want less guidance and more action. For example! A door unlocks - do you really need the game to stop and the camera to pan over and look at it opening? Maybe not! In Streamlined Mode, it doesn’t! This is one of the many examples of reduced guidance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/8f55282bf8998c0963eba0c8d43cfa3c45bde224.jpg
We’ve cut some fat from the dialogue in Streamlined Mode - a line here, a line there... It’s not like we’ve hacked away entire scenes, just trimmed bits for a more…streamlined…experience.

We’ve also added speech bubble portraits to keep track of who’s speaking while you’re speeding through.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/9c8895f728eb7156531977b18affff0bd82ad9c4.png

Finally, we've included some quality of life improvements and changes. We've increased the number of historical autosaves that are kept and we've added a function to restart the current chapter. If you do get stuck somewhere, both of these should help. Autosaves have been moved to a place in the menu that's easier to find and we've added a way to change the language in-game.

The Game Awards Nomination and Sale

We are deeply honoured to be nominated at The Game Awards for Best Family Game and Best Debut Indie. To thank you and everyone who has supported us, we have put the game on sale for 25% off! Just in time for the Holiday Season! 

The Plucky Squire was inspired by the picture books we loved reading to our children. Our dream was always to create something that families could enjoy together. Whoever makes up your family, we hope The Plucky Squire can bring you and your loved ones some joy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/a072ba0ab89bc2f9d0f9ec1b14d493e7b789ffac.gif

Patch Notes
Shiny and New - Streamline Mode:

 Shorter, snappier dialogue that lets you enjoy the story but gets you to the action quicker
 Fewer camera events that slow down player action
 Added dialogue portraits for major characters
 Added an in-game language change option
 Added More Save History slots and moved them to "Load Save" in the "Save Files" menu

Bug fixes

 Fixed soft lock in credits
 Fixed bottom half of Alowynia card being blacked out
 Various fixes to collision issues

notes.title: The Plucky Squire's story starts NOW
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xREgLxEzZE4;full][/previewyoutube]

A story 23 years in the making

As our studio's first game, we are so grateful that people want to play our game. The first inkling of this game started when James & Bidds met in 2001. Though they went their separate ways, they have wanted to make a game together ever since. 

We are so happy that we can share that game with all of you now. This stunning papercraft launch trailer was made with Paper Engineers, Julia Yus and Yeray Pérez Vallejo.

The Plucky Squire is now available. We hope it can bring a bit of the joy we felt while making it.

The story behind the story

On a trip to Japan James ended up in an interview for a certain popular game series you may have heard of. 17 years in Japan later, he had many Pokémon mainline and spinoff games under his belt. 

At the same time Bidds had started his own studio and he was making some very unique stuff. Fluidity was a liquid-based physics puzzler published by Nintendo while The Swords of Ditto blended roguelite elements, branching narratives in an rpg adventure. There was even the Stealth series in between. Which you probably can guess, were stealth games.

After all those escapades and adventures they wanted to return to that original dream. To make their own game together. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/4167a36b78c72821a82e61afeb7b71f92b4a0fe4.png
James had been honing a visual style and even started an online comic series called Cosmic which you can see above. From there, they thought of a game that took place in a book. And from there, they wanted to incorporate the 3D elements they had learned along the way. And so the concept of The Plucky Squire was born. A game in a storybook where you could jump out of the book and into the real 3D world. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/0dadb2a7edc42b052310f94f2dc79c01c0598543.png

This would be a big technical challenge especially for a very small team. Making fully fleshed out 2D and 3D gameplay would almost be like making 2 entire games. But by putting their heads together, they figured it out. To switch seamlessly between the dimensions the game would render both worlds at the same time, overlaying the 2D gameplay onto 3D objects. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/4af5e191875957a425cd14ba966d380b78ccbe7f.jpg
From everyone at All Possible Futures, thank you for playing The Plucky Squire. We hope it's a story to remember.

If you liked reading about development, there is also the Deluxe Edition containing a curated collection of concept art in the form of a digital art book and the official soundtrack by Mike Georgiades. Getting them all together saves you 15% on the whole bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627570/The_Plucky_Squire/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44990/The_Plucky_Squire_Deluxe_Edition/

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=fMc0RUJQLqo;full][/previewyoutube]
Here's the final gameplay preview of The Plucky Squire! It only shows a small early part of the game and we still have many surprises in store.

A Small Preview

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/9804159e287a714e25e76c692ba4ad3f11eb56ae.gif

Our heroes have chosen to travel through Sonnet Swamps. But when they reach there, they find that they are ill-equipped to help the locals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/a7d95d20b3f586d03dc03665dfe015902541366a.gif

Perhaps Jot can use his new found powers to find help in the other realm. It even looks like some of the book's critters have escaped there as well. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/7bb5477fac6929b13b473f4de17c13add7d417ce.gif

He'll need to take on these challenges with courage, no matter how many times they may knock him down! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/ff7ee9e741aed8d89e3ba1a2955027747ac07118.gif

There it is! The elven bow! But how can we convince Alwonyia to help us? Watch the whole preview to find out.

The Plucky Squire's connection to Shrek?
Our whole team is very busy getting everything ready for launch on September 17 but I have a few things to share from our co-founder, James Turner.

Brazilian fans may have noticed that the narrator in Brazilian Portuguese is none other than Mauro Ramos, voice of Shrek, Pumba from The Lion King and Sully from Monsters Inc. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/c1e3a8dd95a3f19bd48792ad2a5bb909d263bbd9.png
Another Game We Love
To celebrate the launch of another colorful and playful game today, James has drawn this crossover art with a certain Bot. There are so many amazing games out right now, so we really appreciate that our small team is being put in the same conversations as them!

notes.title: We are launching The Plucky Squire on September 17!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4DpvZWrts_M;full][/previewyoutube]

The tale of The Plucky Squire will begin September 17, 2024!

A message from us
From the heights of Honey Peak to the shores of Boogie Beach, we can’t wait to share our debut game and the world of The Plucky Squire with you. 

It's been a long road to get here and it's hard to believe that we'll finally be launching in one month. But in spite of the hours, months and years that have gone into it, it has truly been a joy making this game. 

Our aim was to capture the childhood wonder of playing games. Games on screens, on tabletops and in the world of make-believe. We initially planned for the game to be about 3-5 hours long but as development progressed, it felt right to try and fit in more and more of those wondrous moments. 

So we've doubled that initial content and we expect you to take about 8-10 hours in a first playthrough! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/25c693a128955e822dfad6f0d3212e90428f3bf0.gif

Early Prototypes
As we approach launch, we've been looking back at some of the very early tech tests. Back then, we weren't even sure whether the scope of what we envisioned was possible with our resources. Things have come a long way since then!

Let us know if you'd like to see more about the game and our development! You can follow us here on Steam to see everything we share. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/d57fdfc0a6f264667401e087f465f6b4215f54da.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/18448c9c153cd8961dc5027a298b625cbfd8a336.gif

Your tale begins on September 17
Finally, we'd like to thank you for following our game's progress. Individually, we've worked on a lot of games, but this is the first one we're making as All Possible Futures. You've shown faith in us and we hope we can repay it with a special experience on September 17. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/150414f549ebeed5c9c231427e6c752756f6aa11.gif
